description.html: This oval water dish has an elongated shape and walls styled as reddish rock, with lighter, faded-looking areas along the rim. The inside is smooth and evenly brown, so you can easily see whether the water is clean.

The elongated shape is handy for snakes. A snake that can fit its whole body into the dish will happily soak in it, especially before shedding, when moisture helps the skin come off more easily. When choosing a dish for bathing, check that your snake can coil up inside it. For larger individuals this dish serves as a water bowl.
The oval form is easy to place along the back or side glass, and the reddish tones match terrariums with brown and red substrates.

Fill the dish only so far that the water does not overflow when your animal gets in. Change the water every day, and right after bathing, since snakes often defecate in water. Wash the dish with warm water and a brush, and clean it thoroughly once a week.
